name: rm-guard
description: Stops the agent from deleting files without your say-so: reads rm, del, Remove-Item, find -delete through wrappers, shows you what would be deleted and asks before it runs.

commands.title: Commands that stop
commands.description: Names separated by commas. A call of any of them is asked about or refused, unless every target is inside the allowed paths. Delete a name to let that command through. Empty means all of the defaults.

allowPaths.title: Allowed paths
allowPaths.description: Paths separated by semicolons where deletion passes without asking, for example node_modules;dist. Relative paths count from the project folder. A disk root, your home folder, the project folder itself and .git are always refused.
